newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly down in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly down in listless trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished slightly lower in listless trade on Saturday due to the absence of market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.493 against Friday's T$27.492 close. Turnover was a thin US$45 million in the shortened weekend session. A stable range was seen for next week.

Many players have retreated to the sidelines on Saturday, dealers said. A central bank board meeting earlier on Saturday decided to leave Taiwan's monetary policy unchanged. "The forex market did not expect the central bank to adjust its monetary policy in today's meeting," a dealer said. -- Alice Hung (2-5080815)
